author: Mark Atwood
text:
Closing 2026-05-13. Spec edits landed in ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec:

  * ba6a5eb — spec: move non-member field trim from Space/query to Space/get (the prompt-driven AI commit)
  * b2e88f4 — spec: tighten isPubliclyPreviewable field doc (Mark's follow-up clarifying dual-mode discovery: /get works for any non-member with the id, /query discovery requires isPublic:true filter)

All grep verification gates pass. Diff is +9 lines (vs. prompt's +20-25 estimate — the AI was efficient, no over-editing).

This unblocks JMAP-v9py.4 (Space/get non-member field projection) and JMAP-v9py.20 (notFound enforcement). Both bead acceptance criteria still match the as-shipped spec text.
